title: ParametricBand dynamic integration, visualization data, CMakeLists update
description:
Integrate DynamicProcessor into ParametricBand so each band can run static or dynamic EQ, expose dynamic visualization data for the GUI, and register phase-C sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole CMakeLists.txt owner for phase C.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp (phase B static band engine)
- Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.h/.cpp and EnvelopeFollower.h/.cpp
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from phase B
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §4.1–4.5 and §3 (band still does not own M/S encode)

Implement integration in Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp:
1. Each ParametricBand owns or embeds a DynamicProcessor (or optional unique composition) with setters forwarding mode, detector source, threshold/ratio/knee/range, attack/release, and enable-dynamics flag. Static mode remains default and must match prior static behavior when dynamics disabled or mode==staticEq.
2. process() path: build DetectorContext from available channel taps / external SC buffer pointers passed into process (extend process signature only as needed; document ownership). Apply DynamicProcessor gain to the band’s EQ contribution (scale effective gain dB or post-filter makeup) per-sample or per-block with existing smoothers; still no per-band M/S encode/decode.
3. Expose getDynamicVisualizationData() (or band-level getters) for GUI: static curve params already available + dynamic fields from DynamicProcessor.
4. 12-band container (ParametricEQ) prepare/reset propagates to each band’s DynamicProcessor. No heap in process.
5. CMakeLists.txt: add Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.cpp, Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.cpp, and tests/DynamicEQTests.cpp to the appropriate plugin/DSP and ShredEQUnitTests source lists using the same style as existing entries. Do not refactor unrelated targets.

Do NOT implement unit test bodies (c.4), PluginProcessor processBlock final wiring beyond what ParametricBand API needs, or GUI paint code.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp integrate DynamicProcessor with per-band mode/detector/threshold controls
When dynamics disabled or mode is staticEq, band behavior remains static EQ equivalent to prior static path
ParametricBand exposes dynamic visualization data suitable for GUI (threshold, detector level, GR/current gain, reaction flags)
Stereo routing remains channel masking only — no per-band M/S encode/decode added
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.cpp, Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.cpp, and tests/DynamicEQTests.cpp on the correct targets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.* beyond includes/usage from ParametricBand
modify tests/DynamicEQTests.cpp body (c.4 owns the test file content)
implement energy-normalized M/S encode/decode inside ParametricBand

allowed: embed DynamicProcessor by value inside ParametricBand
extend process signature with optional DetectorContext or SC pointers
scale static gain dB by dynamic modulation before coefficient update or after filter
append phase-C sources to existing CMake lists only
forbidden: heap allocate per block in process
